labels.name: security
labels.description: Security controls; private reports use advisories

milestones.title: M1: Normative profile
milestones.description: Resolve implementation-blocking ambiguities and accept exact shared contracts.

milestones.title: M2: Portable core
milestones.description: Independent PSP/CDL implementations with shared byte vectors and differential tests.

milestones.title: M3: Reference services
milestones.description: MCP and HTTP services with authenticated, tenant-scoped contracts.

milestones.title: M4: MCPProxy
milestones.description: Mediated tool dispatch and governed responses.

milestones.title: M5: LLMProxy
milestones.description: Authoritative model/tool loop and input/output governance.

milestones.title: M6: Interoperability and effectiveness
milestones.description: Mixed-language stacks, adversarial study, baselines and ablations.

milestones.title: M7: Reviewed release
milestones.description: Independent review, packaging, provenance, documentation and scoped claims.

issues.title: Resolve PSP signed-byte formula, metadata binding and expiration boundaries
issues.body:
Resolve PSP-E001 through PSP-E004 in specs/errata/README.md. Publish a reviewed profile and valid/invalid exact-byte vectors, including metadata mutation, expiration equality, Unicode and numeric edge cases. No conformance claim until resolved.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Extract normative requirements and deterministic CDL policy tables
issues.body:
Expand the starter register to every MUST/MUST NOT. Review CDL inheritance, negation authority, unknown terms, Appendix B matrices, and engine versus proxy guarantees. Accept vectors with documented reason codes.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Implement TypeScript PSP core and CDL policy engine
issues.body:
Implement reviewed parser, canonicalization, signature/time/key checks and CDL rules. Add negative controls, bounded parser behavior and fuzz regressions. Pass accepted shared vectors without treating blocked cases as passes.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Implement Python PSP core and CDL policy engine
issues.body:
Implement reviewed contracts independently in Python. Match TypeScript on accepted byte vectors and complete policy outcomes. Include malformed, expired, revoked, tampered and legitimate controls.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Define API/MCP contracts and implement reference services in both languages
issues.body:
Create draft OpenAPI and MCP schemas, the eleven PSP section 22.5.2 tools, synthetic governed data and adversarial test servers. Test tenant binding, authentication, atomic persistence, replay and transport interoperability.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Implement MCPProxy in TypeScript and Python
issues.body:
Enforce node affinity, trusted capability discovery, CDL decisions and response provenance. Bind checked state to actual dispatch. Demonstrate denied calls never reach downstream spies, including races and topology bypass.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Implement LLMProxy and provider-neutral dispatch loop in both languages
issues.body:
Implement signed prompt construction, pre-inference data policy, tool dispatch and output/display gating, completion policy and refresh. Begin with mock providers. Prove streaming, tenant and stale-state behavior before live-provider opt-in.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Run cross-language topology matrix and preregister effectiveness study
issues.body:
Follow evaluation/PROTOCOL.md with unprotected, PSP-only, CDL-only and combined conditions, A/B/C topology and mixed stacks. Publish task utility, forbidden side effects, disclosure, uncertainty, costs and exclusions.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.

issues.title: Prepare independently reviewed reference release
issues.body:
Obtain independent security review; build repeatable packages/images with SBOMs and provenance. Document compatibility and precisely scoped conformance. Appoint independent reviewers and enable required approvals before a production-readiness claim.

See ROADMAP.md for sequencing and acceptance gates.
